project.name: Call Me Maybe
project.summary: Build a kind, safe outbound voice agent that contacts consenting clinical-trial prospects, explains a study using approved wording, asks pre-screening questions, schedules a research-team visit, and escalates to a human when needed.

problem_statement.summary: Clinical-trial coordinators often cannot promptly contact interested patients because outreach competes with clinic duties. Calls may be delayed, voicemails go unanswered, screening answers are not consistently structured, and interested patients may disengage.

mission.goal: Create an outbound voice agent for clinical-trial outreach and pre-screening.
inputs: Call list from a pre-screen packet or ad responses

clinical_trial_context.operating_model: The agent supports a hospital or clinic research team, not the drug company, and may work alongside existing hospital systems such as the EHR.
clinical_trial_context.script_policy: All study-related wording presented to patients must be IRB-approved in a real deployment. Demo scripts based on public data must be clearly labeled as not IRB-approved.
clinical_trial_context.screening_policy: The agent may collect basic pre-screen answers, but final eligibility decisions belong to the research team.

key_terms.outreach_or_pre_screen_call: First contact to gauge interest and basic fit.
key_terms.IRB_approved_script: Wording approved by the relevant ethics review board.
key_terms.escalation: Handing a call to a human.
key_terms.TCPA: U.S. law governing automated and artificial-voice calls.
key_terms.opt_out: A patient's request not to be contacted again.
key_terms.turn_taking: How the voice agent determines when to speak or listen.

steps: Manually work through a call list
Ask screening questions from a paper script
known_failure_points: Answers are not captured in a structured format
Interested patients may not be contacted at convenient times

core_capabilities: Outbound voice calls to consenting people only
Automated-voice disclosure at the beginning of each call
Plain-language delivery of approved study wording
safety_requirements: Confirm valid consent to be called before outreach
Disclose that the caller is automated at the start of every call
Offer access to a human at any point
Honor opt-outs and suppress future calls
Do not make final clinical-trial eligibility decisions
Use only public or synthetic data for the hackathon
In the demo, call only teammates' phones

emergency_example.trigger: Patient mentions chest pain or another possible emergency.
emergency_example.required_behavior: Stop the screening flow and direct the person to call 911 immediately.

human_escalation_triggers: Patient is confused or repeatedly gives unclear answers

good.name: Scripted Caller
good.target: A demonstrable prototype by approximately hour 10.

better.name: Safe Caller
additional_features: Graceful refusal to provide medical advice

best.name: Recruitment Desk Agent
additional_features: Retries only at permitted times and where allowed
Write summaries to a mock EHR or CTMS
Statuses for interested, booked, opted out, and escalated

telephony.name: Twilio Voice
telephony.demo_constraint: Use trial accounts and call only teammates' phones.

public_data_sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov API
public_data_sources.use: Study descriptions and eligibility criteria; any generated demo script must be labeled not IRB-approved.

public_data_sources.name: Synthea
public_data_sources.use: Synthetic patient data for a demo call list.

public_data_sources.name: FCC AI voice/TCPA explainer
public_data_sources.use: Reference for automated/artificial voice call compliance considerations.

patient_personas.expected_outcome: Complete pre-screening and offer/book a visit if appropriate.
Clarify using approved wording; escalate if confusion persists.
Speak clearly, repeat or slow down, and offer a human.
Use a validated supported-language flow or escalate; do not improvise translations of approved study wording.
Remain respectful and honor a request to stop contact.
Stop the call flow and direct the person to call 911 immediately.
Offer or initiate a human handoff.
Do not give medical advice; refer to the research team or appropriate clinical support.

supporting_test_artifacts: Short plain-language demo script marked not IRB-approved
Expected outcome or answer key for every persona

evaluation_criteria.judging_focus: Could more interested patients receive timely, respectful first contact safely?
End-to-end demo runs from a clean clone by following the README.
Use real public data where available and believable, documented synthetic data elsewhere.
Clean code, clear narrative, and useful UI.
